question: How many funds were allocated for senior citizens and persons with disabilities in Union Budget 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹9,500 Cr**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 112 of the Indian Constitution states about **Annual Financial Statement (Budget)**.

 
 
• The **term budget** is **nowhere** mentioned in the constitution.
 
• It is prepared by the **Department of Economic Affairs** in the Finance Ministry.
 
• It is a statement of the **estimated receipts and expenditures** of the Government of India. 
 
• The aim of budget 2020 was **caring society, economic development and aspirational India**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The budget is of three types 

 
• **Balance budget**- It is the one where **Total Receipts are equal to Total Expenditure**.
 
• **Deficit budget**-In this budget **Total R****eceipts are less than Total E****xpenditure**.
 
• **Surplus budget**-It is one where **Total Receipts are more than Total E****xpenditure**.​

 
• **Stages of Budget enactment**

 
• Presentation of Budget
 
• General Discussion
 
• Scrutiny by department committees
 
• Voting in demands for grants
 
• Passing of appropriation bill
 
• Passing of finance bill.
